title: The Latest Crier for Sep 08, 2026
items:
Weekly Prayer! (30 minutes)

Struggling or feeling burdened? Want to pray over your friends, campus, & the world? This is the place for you. Meet in the Chapel, every Thursday at 11 am to pray as a community! It doesn’t take much, just bring yourself & an open heart. "This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us." 1 John 5:14
